DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe).

Given your recent influenza diagnosis and non-adherence to treatment, combined with purulent sputum, I strongly suspect a bacterial superinfection. I will need to review your chest X-ray immediately to confirm the location of the infiltrate and assess severity.
